properties.name: embedding.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable image embedding auto-configuration.

properties.name: embedding.fail-on-missing-model
properties.description: Fail application startup when the image embedding model cannot be loaded.

properties.name: embedding.image-input-size
properties.description: Target input size in pixels for the vision model.

properties.name: embedding.vision-model-url
properties.description: Remote identifier or URL for the image embedding model.

properties.name: embedding.predictor-pool-size
properties.description: Number of image predictors kept in the bounded pool.

properties.name: embedding.async-loading
properties.description: Load the image embedding model asynchronously at startup.
